payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the sentence reordering (SR) task is the most effective for pre-training, as it consistently achieves the highest performance metrics compared to the other tasks.

claims.text: The sentence reordering (SR) task is the most effective pre-training task, outperforming the other tasks (NSG and MDG).
Using all three tasks together during pre-training can lead to better performance than using them individually.
